reviews.text: Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Friendly and kind staff. Our time at Metro Paw - Skillman was a great experience. Special thanks to Dr. Compass and the team who quickly responded and provided treatment options for our dear Tuxi. We highly recommend this animal hospital!

Metro Paws Skillman provides excellent care from every vet and you can guarantee great service and empathy when dealing with your fur baby. They are quick, efficient, and work with you regarding cost. We have been coming here for years and they will always have a loyal customer in me!
Excellent staff and facilities! Dr. Scott is the best, knowledgeable, capable, and professional. My boy is always in great hands here. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares.

The best vet office in Dallas! All of the vets here are wonderful. We typically see Dr. Jarvis or Dr. Williams. But honestly, all of the vets are so caring and detail-oriented. The front-desk staff is great about reminding you of annuals, vaccines, and they are on top of following-up after a visit. The staff will sit on the floor with me with my small dogs during visits - whether it’s a vet-tech or the vet. They also use easy-cheese as a treat to distract the dogs - which is genius! Especially if you have food motivated fur babies like we do. I feel very confident about bringing my fur babies here knowing that they are getting the best possible care.

I left this place completely in love. The service is fantastic, the doctors are top-notch. I was so blessed that since 2022, KIM has been under the care of Dr. Iván Álvarez, who became my baby's "Pediatrician" (we love him) 🐶. Later, Dr. Mychelle Scott and Dr. Colton Jarvis continued to see her with such kindness and compassion, treating KIM with such compassion. From the moment you walk in, you feel safe and at ease. The reception staff is incredibly friendly, and I especially loved David; he's gentle and extraordinary.
It's worth noting that in 2021, I experienced one of the most devastating moments a dog mother can endure. Due to medical negligence at another veterinary clinic, KIM's father, Pinky, died. My heart was broken, and I didn't trust any veterinarian. It was here at Metro Paws Veterinary Clinic that they restored my faith and confidence. Thank you from the bottom of my heart ♥️

I have been going to metro paws on skillman for the last 5 years. I have 3 dogs in different life stages. They are professional, kind and compassionate with all my dogs and myself. I highly recommend using them for your veterinary needs.

Ashleigh and Dr. Williams are literal angels! Vet visits can be so stressful and confusing, but these sweetie pies put you at ease instantly. They are so smart, informative, and patient, and it’s obvious how much they care for animals. Love you, Metro Paws!! <3

We had an excellent experience at this veterinary clinic. The entire staff was incredibly kind, caring, and professional. They treated our dog with so much love and made us feel comfortable and confident throughout the visit. We truly appreciate the wonderful care they provided and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinarian who genuinely cares about their patients. ❤️🐾
They take great care of Scout here. And so far I’m really seeing the benefits of the Snout plan too. Everyone is always kind and helpful!

Great experience! Thank you to Dr. Scott and vet technician Ashleigh for taking such great care of my cat Marlow today. Everyone was incredibly friendly, and Dr. Scott even sat on the floor with my cat and me while explaining the plan and our options. They truly go above and beyond to keep you informed and make sure your pet is well cared for.
Dr. Jarvis and Luna X. were very kind and supportive when it was time for my elderly cat to leave this world. It’s never easy but they made it peaceful for us and I am grateful.
Great staff, affordable service, and a clean facility! Our vet tech today was Ashleigh and she was wonderful in handling my nervous dog.

All three of my Shelties were treated with love and dignity by these wonderful veterinarians, Dr. Sarpong and Dr. Lavender. My adopted boys had many problems, but they were treated with respect, even down to their last breath.

Thank you Ashleigh for doing such a great job getting our Garbo calm.  You have a special talent in earning her trust so quickly.  What an easy appointment - great coordination with you and Dr. Jarvis to keep the poking and prodding to a minimum.
I rescue Great Danes so im here almost weekly. I've been to probably 50 different vets and this is my favorite. They're very knowledgeable, attentive and compassionate.
Love this clinic! Always kind, caring and friendly. Everyone there is awesome and on their game.

Amazing experience! Dr. Williams was kind, thorough, and took great care of Denver. I never felt rushed, and I could tell she genuinely cared about Denver and wanted the best for him! Francisco was gentle and compassionate, and Luna at the front desk was friendly and even called a few days later to check on my baby after his vaccinations. Everyone made us feel comfortable from start to finish. Thank you all for taking such great care of my pup and me!
We recently moved to Texas from New York City, and one of my biggest concerns was finding a vet we could trust for our Yorkies. Everyone here has been so welcoming, kind, and caring from day one!

Absolutely love Metro Paws at Skillman! As a first-time dog mom, I’ve been the definition of a nervous Nelly😂 From day one, the team has been incredibly communicative, kind, and reassuring, always taking the time to answer my questions and put my mind at ease. It is a little pricey but the top-notch care is absolutely worth it!

Oso and I are so very thankful!<3
Staff is awesome
Amazing attention to detail and care, love coming here
Love this clinic! The staff and doctors are wonderful. They are open 7 days a week so very convenient and I feel like they take the time to listen and talk to me about my concerns. Highly recommend!
We had another enjoyable visit today - this time with Dr. Scott & Sara. Dr. Deresz, Gates, and their team have always been great with Bardo over the years.

New to the area was looking for a new vet for my pug and came across Metro paws off skillman , Dr Deresz and his tech Francisco were absolutely amazing and caring. I loved how they took the time to explain everything and made my pug feel comfortable, highly recommend if your looking for a vet!

Dr. Jarvis and the tech did an amazing job with our Max. I needed a same day appointment due to an emergency and they were able to accommodate me. Everyone is so nice and caring! Will definitely go back and 100% recommend.

What was supposed to be a simple eye exam, turned into the worst week of mine and my baby girls life. She probably still would have had more days with me if the staff kept her kidney disease in mind when prescribing her a medication that basically killed her. Heartbroken cant even describe the amount of pain I feel. No words truly can describe how hurt and crushed I am. Delilah was my best friend and soul dog of 18 years, she didn't have to suffer and hurt and go the way she did. I probably will never recover from this heart ache. She was supposed to walk down the aisle with me. We've been best friends for 18 years. I am shattered.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Fantastic staff, sweet fun people, docs are great. Been through some hard times in that office, but they're really caring and I feel the standard of care is top notch and they seem well-equipped with modern tech. They're understanding about spending major bucks on an aging pet, no guilt-trips, I don't feel like someone's worrying about their boat payment! You can tell they really love animals, it really shows across the board. Everything's expensive these days, I'd say it's a reasonable value cost-wise - seems like top-notch care for basic health and some emergencies.
Took care of my kitten I will be going back!!!

The doctors and techs are well informed and have excellent technique.  They take their time with your pet and offer options for treatment so that the client can decide how to proceed.  Appointments are readily available and office hours are generous.
Very professional and listen to your concerns. Also prices are very affordable and reasonable!

Sara and Dr. Jarvis were both incredibly kind, patient, knowledgeable, and informative. I felt like the truly cared about my pet, as well as educating me and helping me understand what was going on with her so that we can get her better. Highly recommend!

I can’t say enough great things about the vets and staff at Metro Paws.  I always have such a great experience with the entire team- they all really treat your pets like family.

Luna and all  the front desk team are all friendly, welcoming, organized and great with my dogs, taking the time to make them, as well as me, feel welcome and  comfortable.   They make  check-in easy and take  the time to answer questions, schedule additional appointments or pick up meds for my pups

Sara M, the vet tech, is kind, patient, and  very knowledgeable. She took care of my pup with care and compassion and goes above and beyond.

Dr Williams is an outstanding vet and really takes the  time to thoroughly explain everything, discuss options, and make sure I felt confident in the care plan, as well as treating my pup with care and compassion.

I’m so grateful to have found a place where all of my pups are treated with such kindness and love.  Highly recommend!

I’ve been taking all 3 of my pets to Metro Paws Animal Hospital - Skillman for about a year now and have always had such a great experience. The staff is so kind, caring, and helpful.

I recently had an emergency with my dog and they went above and beyond. They literally came out to my car and carried her inside for me. They made such a stressful situation feel so much easier. I’m so grateful for everyone there and would highly recommend them.

Today was my first time visiting them. Their service was amazing. Dr. Scott and Kiersten went above and beyond for my kitten They were gentle and kind with him highly recommend this place. SN: Dr. Scott and Kirsten had amazing communication skills!
Luna and Michelle, great.

Love being able to schedule online. Really pleased with Dr Jarvis and his tech, Michelle, and front desk person Esther. Dr Jarvis was able to get our fidgety Siamese to calm down and relax in his lap. Amazing!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

This was our first visit for Rocco, and we had such a great experience with Dr. Jarvis and his team.

Dr. Jarvis explained Rocco’s care plan so clearly and thoroughly, and you can truly feel how much he cares. I was honestly surprised at how Rocco just calmly followed him without any fuss — that says a lot!

Francisco, the tech, was gentle and kind, and made Rocco feel comfortable right away. Velvet at the front desk was very professional and welcoming, making our visit smooth from start to finish.

We’re so grateful to have found such a caring team for Rocco. Highly recommend! 🐾

I have been a client at this location of MetroPaws for over 10 years, with the primary reasons being the excellence in medical care for our family pets, however, in my last visit the excellence in client care was also proven to be beyond anyone's expectation.  Our highly fearful dog became lose in the parking area, zig-zagging across and up and down Skillman for approximately 15 minutes until he was caught.  Without the help from clinic personnel, I fear what could have happened.  I want to highlight Vanessa who brought out treats and an extra leash and, of course, Dr., Deresz who is brilliant!  There is no better vet clinic for anyone's animal -

Cat parents STAY AWAY!! Read the 1 star reviews!! Trust me. The staff is completely incompetent. Sedated my cat and left her alone in her carrier for over an hour without notifying me or my husband that she wasn’t actually going to be treated today and that she could come home. Absolute monsters. They also can’t seem to get ahold of their records and history of your visits. I have to remind them wha’s going on with my cat every time??? And she’s had the same illness this entire time?? Seriously this place is a joke. They are also wayyy too packed and will give your animal the barest of bare minimum attention. I would avoid it all together.  I’ve seen multiple people unhappy at the front desk… don’t waist your money and save your pets the trauma. It’s not worth it.
We are sorry to see you had a negative experience and would love the opportunity to learn more. Please contact us directly to ensure any outstanding issues are resolved.

This was my first time at the Skillman  location for my 5 year old Shelties tooth extraction.  Everyone was very friendly, helpful and upbeat.  Darren, the Senior surgical tech, was very calm and reassuring prior to my dog’s tooth extraction which was comforting.  I was able to ask questions of our longtime vet, Dr. Jennifer Lavender, whom we adore.  She also was great at clarifying any questions I had and explained the procedure in great detail.  My dog also had his teeth cleaned and scaled at the same time he was sedated so everything worked out beautifully.  I always feel very confident when I use Dr. Lavender for any procedure and appreciate her passion for what she does because it is A+++

I had a great experience at Metro Paws! The prices were very reasonable and the facility was nice. The receptionist wasn’t the most welcoming when we came in, but he was helpful and got us into a room quickly. The technician and doctor were thorough and sweet! They took great care of my baby. We will definitely recommend this location to our friends in Dallas.

Love this vet! I am new to Metro Paws and have brought one cat and one dog here so far. The receptionists are always wonderful - very helpful and friendly but professional. Two different vets I have seen were both great as well. They’re helping me keep my old man kitty as healthy as possible! Highly recommend!

We have used this location twice-once for a non-anesthetic dental on our dog, and yesterday for an emergency with our senior cat. The staff both times worked with us on scheduling/working in so we could get the care needed. We were thankful they were open on a Sunday also.
Dr.Jarvis and his tech Michelle were so sweet to my boy butters and showed so much love!🤗 he was just here for his annual and got spoiled with a photoshoot and churu! …

This is my second dog they have taken care of and they have been phenomenal! Highly recommend them for all your pet needs.

Adding these photos of the cute things they do to make your experience even better!
Dr. Jarvis. 0/10
Esther and rest of the crew are the best team!  5 stars every time!
Hamilton my cat was so well taken care of by Essence and Dr. Jarvis.  Wonderful staff of people I would highly recommend!
Esther and David are amazing !!! I’ve been coming to Metro Paws for couple years now and it’s such a family atmosphere.

I’ve taken my cat to Metro Paws for 2-3 years now, and I’ve always had a really pleasant experience. Everyone has been incredibly kind and patient, but I really wanted to mention Darren and Dr. Jarvis especially. Darren was the tech I worked with before Lana’s dental appointment, and he really went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable with everything. There was no such thing as a stupid question with Darren, and he’s 100% someone I want to work with again. Darren clearly knows his stuff, is very friendly, and very approachable. Dr. Jarvis really knows how to level with you, regardless of your medical background (or lack there of). I always appreciate how he tries to incorporate you in your pet’s care and make sure it’s a team effort.  It’s apparent how much these two love their jobs, and I’m so grateful for both of them!

Every time I have brought my cats in for an appointment the staff has been phenomenal. Everyone is so kind and caring. I always get a follow up message asking how the cats are doing. Every time I call with a question, they give great advice filled with kindness and empathy. So grateful for all the Metro-Paws, Skillman, staff!

September 2025
The staff is caring. My dog,  Tamela loves going there. I board her when I leave town or have the vet see her with any problems. Love this location 5+ Stars.

I’ve been going to MetroPaws Skillman 10+ years. They have been a constant because of the absolutely ridiculous ailments all my pets have! I try to exclusively see Dr. Deresz for all appointments. But, I recently had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Michelle Scott. She was knowledgeable, thorough, and had an excellent bedside manner. I would definitely recommend her and all the staff at MetroPaws!
Very kind team

I was very impressed by Dr. Deresz’s thorough examination of our dog Scout. He reviewed prior records, gave thorough physical checks, caught Scout up on vaccinations and tests, and gave common sense recommendations for Scout’s future health. This was all within a very reasonable fee and I would recommend Metro Paws for all my furry friends.

Terrible experience. Do not bring your animals to this vet. My main concern was a possible ear infection during our visit. The vet had terrible bedside manner and “forgot” to look in my dogs ear during the physical exam. I asked her if she could and she responded with it will be another 60 dollars. The physical exam (which I never saw) was 120 dollars. Please do not go to this vet. I have never felt so terrible leaving a vet office. Do not take your animals here. I am a nurse practitioner myself and would never sit down in the floor to speak with my patients.
Thank you for your positive review! We appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again.

They have been our go-to vet for the last five years since we moved to the grove. Awesome service, awesome staff, and you can tell they love and care about their patients as much as you do. You are getting premium care so the price may not be right for everyone but my critters have had exceptional recoveries from any spaying and neutering. The only drawback is that it's located in a booj neighborhood so you will have to be comfortable around wypipo. I'm cautious when I go because I've seen "Karen" behavior when visiting from customers. The Doctors and staff are the best. I would recommend them to everyone because your loved one will be treated by the best team!
I am very please with the care my pugs gets from Metro. The staff are very kind, we are always greeted  by name when we walk in, it is  also clean, I feel as if the clinic is a well run place.

Wonderful veterinarian office, friendly staff and fantastic doctors. Dr. Campbell found our dog’s cancerous tumor at a routine visit, leading to referral for removal which effectively saved his life. Very communicative, always respond to my concerns quickly and seriously. The doctors truly care about our pets and the work that they do. We are lucky to have them in the neighborhood.

My cat Daryl was having tooth pain and they took wonderful care of him. He had to get a few removed. We just got home from his dental today and is already eating and going back to his normal self. The staff were in love with him you can just tell how passionate they are about their job and that they love what they do. He normally hated going to the vet but seemed relaxed here as you can tell by the pics he knew they were gonna help him 😊

I would give them zero stars if I could! No attention to detail. I was asked what food my pet ate and then 30 minutes later asked again. I was told my pup had anxiety another vet told me the opposite. I was told to feed an under weight dog that runs 5 miles a day and goes to the dog park 900 calories a day. Then I was told if you let me know what you feed her I can tell you how much that is. Uhm I told you twice now what I’m feeding her and 900 is a calorie deficit for an active 49 pound dog. I was told I need to get all new vaccines for my dog. This is not the case. I was told to give my dog 200mg of trazodone before her next visit. I refused to come back because there was no way I was knocking my dog out because the vet is insane and doesn’t want to take the necessary steps to calm my dog for $75 dollars. I will never return.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Staff is kind. Place is very clean. I went in only for shots and specifically stated I did not want a heartworm test because my dogs 99% indoors. The tech went ahead. Did not enjoy high pressure sales tactic. Ended spending the $100. Will not be returning.
I love the fact that they like my 15 year old dog. They always tell me how sweet he is when he gets his Librella shot!
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!

I want to start by giving this hospital a 10-star rating! They were incredibly kind and sweet to my cat, Luna, and to Mitchell, who took her to the hospital. They took X-rays of Luna in hopes that she could survive, but unfortunately, due to her severely damaged chin, we had to make the difficult decision to put her to sleep. I was heartbroken, but I'm so grateful for the understanding and support they provided during this tough time. If you ever need help with your furry friend or are looking for a trustworthy hospital and doctors, I highly recommend this place. You and your pet will not regret it. A big shoutout to the doctor! ❤️‍🩹✨
Very professional and caring!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Not satisfied with how my cat was handled for an x-ray. They had to give a sedative and could not give her fluids even with the sedative. She came back with pain in her paw, I could tell only after so I requested to be with her for the following appointment. They told me I could be there with her for the following ultrasound but would not allow me to be with her when the appointment came. I felt it was best for me to be present during her ultrasound, not only for her general well being & proper after-care but also my peace of mind and her comfort. Took her to VEG where they handled everything, let me be with her throughout the entire procedure, and billed me a quarter of the costs for double the meds. Will likely not come back.
Hello! Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! WOW! 5 STARS! We truly appreciate you! -Metro Paws Animal Hospital - Skillman Team

I went there with my 8-year-old cat he was drooling from the mouth and in a lot of pain they didn't even check him they didn't even open his mouth or weigh him or anything all the doctor said was he needed some teeth to be extracted
Always friendly and helpful staff. I would recommend them to anyone with a pet. 🐶 …
Love this place they always take great care of our English Bulldog!! Good customer service
Really care and follow up

Loved this place, after my go to vet closed down it has been hard finding somewhere personable. After coming here I will not be looking for another vet! The front staff was nice and welcoming. Our tech Pedro was very friendly and knowledgeable as to what he was doing. The vet was very sweet as well got right to the point and did not try to oversell! Love that! Anyways all of this to say this clinic is amazing!
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!

Today I had a scare with my pup eating something that she shouldn’t have eaten. I frantically brought my dog in for a same day appointment and let me tell you, this was the best experience I’ve ever had at any type of pet related appointment. When I got there, Darren took care of me and my dog like we were his own family. His passion for what he does shows through the way he spoke to me and loved on my dog! He reassured me that her condition was easily treatable in which he gave me step by step instructions and answered questions I didn’t even know I had. The way that each person I talked to at the clinic came together to help me has restored my faith in humanity. Kindness really goes a long way especially in such an emotional and stressful situation. I will forever recommend metro paws to anyone I know that has pet health needs, and they have a lifelong customer as long as I have a pet in need.

I’d give 10 stars if I could! I’ve been taking my two doodles there for over three years. We’ve seen every doctor and one time or another and each one has been extremely caring and knowledgable. Dr, Deresz has gone above beyond my expectations helping me to care for one of my dogs with a complex lameness issue  The front desk team is is top notch - Joanna, David, Ryan, Chyna, Ester-are so quick to respond to all of my requests and help my visits with an anxious and reactive pup easier.
Great clinic.  Have always taken  the best care of my babies!
This place is AWESOME! My dogs have always received the best care here. Friendly, caring, and very attentive staff. I've been coming here for 14 years and will be a life-long client.

I adore Metro Paws on Skillman.  They have an exam room for cats only and it makes my cat Flower so much happier.  They are so good with her even though she can be a little grumpy!  We had a health scare and they snapped her right out of it.
Dr Deresz and the staff are ridiculously friendly and go above and beyond. Our dogs Apollo and Bacchus love everyone there and they have helped Apollo through a difficult injury.

I had taken my pet there twice within a month and she was clearly unwell... They did xrays and blood work at $700.00 and stated her levels are all normal and Xrays came back great but.... please go to a neurologist... THIS IS WHERE I AM BEYOND UPSET.  I call medvet (3 months out for an apt). I called metropaws Skillman on several occasions trying to understand what to do and what was really wrong with my baby. I sent emails and asked the dr to contact me as she was rapidly decreasing. I spoke to the front desk was told he would call me back, teh one time the dr did call, he said giver her tonight and I will call and check on you tomorrow. I never got the calls, no follow up, half ass results, and honestly just here, take your pet  as we are closing in 5 minutes and wait 3 months for a neurologist. By the way - here is a bunch of pain meds to feed your cat in the interim. WELL... after reviewing her results HER levels were not GREAT AT ALL. I had to request 3 times for her actual results as they provided me with literally nothing and let me believe she was stable but to see a specialist. BULL CRAP! SHE WAS SUFFERING FOR 3 DAYS AFTER THAT APT AND SHE IS NOW DEAD. Please take your pet elsewhere. Somewhere where the Dr. follows through with returning calls and actually care about your animal and you as a pet owner. My heart is shattered and totally broken that I let her suffer in the state she was in.  I am so pissed that my poor baby was suffering, and they lied and stated her levels were fine. YOU SHOULD BE ASHAMED OF YOURSELVES. TAKE YOUR FUR FAM SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

*UPDATE: I received a call yesterday within an hour of my review. I was told that there were no abnormalities and the lab results were good. Charlotte was only stressed. You couldn’t even call me back after my emails, and two calls begging for someone to lead me in the right direction with her decline. Funny how when it’s public, it sure grasped attention enough to call me and talk about it all as if I’m not under enough stress and sadness.

Missed appointment? Hmm… That’s awfully convenient to say. What appointment would that be? The euthanasia appointment that I cancelled because I couldn’t bring myself to do in case there was hope? The call yesterday was absolutely immoral and more about business than it was about caring for me or Charlotte. You didn’t know she died until the post. If you cared you would have called and done more communication then send me off with literally nothing in hand and just watch her normal but now abnormalities take over her life. She was sick and to just decide a neurologist with out knowing is insane. You could have done more and you should have. Don’t ever call a pet parent after losing their baby to save face. It’s just stomach turning.

I hesitated writing this review for about a year but realized it may help other pet owners. I took my cat in to Metro Paws because she was urinating blood. They couldn’t figure out what was wrong and gave her antibiotics and pretty much told me we’d have to wait it out. She was okay for about a month and then it started again and this time I could tell she was in serious pain. I brought her back and once again, had no idea what it was. I read on the internet it could be bladder stones so I MADE them take an ultrasound and there they were.. 3 huge bladder stones. They told me we had to operate and there was no other way to get them to dissolve. That diet change wouldn’t help her. That this was going to be something she would deal with the rest of her life. I scheduled her surgery and in the meantime changed her diet to medicated food and water to filtered (even thought they told me it wouldn’t help). A WEEK later, she goes in for surgery and they called me to tell me somehow the stones had miraculously disappeared.. I’m not sure if the vets were not taught about the power of diet for pets in school but it truly seemed like they just wanted to operate on her. After that I had many rude encounters with the front staff and decided I couldn’t trust them. Be careful and do your own research.

Dr David Deresz was so helpful in preparing to take my schnoodle over to Hawaii. I absolutely couldn’t have done it without him! All of the staff were helpful and kind, and everyone went out of their way to help me get everything done. Great experience and I would recommend them to everyone!

This place deserves way more then 5 stars. From the minute we called and walked in to the moment we left everyone was so polite and helpful. My dog ended up positive for parvo and the Dr went above and beyond to help us. I couldn’t be more thankful for this place and all the help and care provided. Thank you so much for helping us get back to recovery ❤️‍🩹
If you can look past the rude front desk staff the vets themselves are pretty awesome so 3 stars only to account for them.
Your feedback made our day - we are so glad we exceeded your expectations! If you need anything else, don't hesitate to reach out.

The entire staff were outstanding, from check in to the techs, to the dr. I loved how everyone made the dogs’ comfort during the visit a priority. We’re so happy to have Metro Paws taking care of our family!
clean facility, friendly staff, attentive care, always provides an itemized estimate for services prior to initiating them, knowledgeable veterinary doctors
Hi Richard, we would love to address any areas where we may have missed the mark. Would you mind emailing us to start a conversation? We hope to hear from you soon.
The best place to for your pets

Oooo, my baby puts up a good fight when getting in his crate to go Vet visit not realizing momma is trying to keep him as healthy as possible
He was a very tiny rescue kitten have had him for 13 years …
Thank you Metro Paws Skillman team for a successful visit with Lucy. She & I felt comfortable and had great service & respecting our budget. Thank you again Dr. Deresz and team.
